recommended_next_phase: Human decision required: (Option B) a release-hardening phase to ship the already-verified attachment-only Repository Intelligence integration as a narrow patch (v0.4.2-plausible) with corrected release language, followed by a phase implementing Candidate A (rollback readiness/evidence auto-generation, S-M effort, LOW risk), reprioritized ahead of any future true RI-backed Advisory reasoning consumption attempt (Option A), which this phase reclassified from 3I's S estimate to L given the missing 115W contract amendment, missing real provider, missing production entry point, and F1 provenance-repair precondition.
summary: Decision-only phase (no src/pcae modified). Re-derived from current source/contracts, not inherited conclusions, whether PCAE can now safely complete true RI-backed Advisory reasoning consumption (RI -> canonical AdvisoryContextPackage -> real AdvisoryProvider -> Advisory result), per the human's three-option framework (A: complete true consumption; B: release attachment-only as a patch; C: defer). Freshly enumerated the Advisory subsystem taxonomy (7 subsystems: core/advisory.py Phase 88W deterministic decision engine; advisory/context/advisory_context_builder.py Phase 122E RI-context builder; core/advisory_repository_skills.py Phase 115R AdvisoryProvider framework; core/advisory_context_package.py Phase 115X AdvisoryContextPackage; core/current_acting_model_advisory_provider.py Phase 115S; CLI surfaces; Advisory Runtime Phase 113A, architecturally distinct). Independently confirmed via grep that advisory_repository_skills.py and advisory_context_package.py have zero non-test importers anywhere in src/pcae -- fully mock-only and disconnected by design, exactly as their own module docstrings state. Re-read docs/PHASE_122_REPOSITORY_INTELLIGENCE_ADVISORY_CONSUMPTION_ARCHITECTURE.md directly: Section 3.4 states that placing Repository Intelligence content into a specific AdvisoryContextPackage section requires 'an explicit 115W-contract amendment or extension phase' that 122A itself does not authorize -- so true consumption is architecture/contract-scale work, not a bounded wiring task. Applied a true-consumption acceptance test (does a different valid RI context ever change a reasoning output): confirmed core/advisory.py's would_* fields are structurally invariant to RI, and no automatic invocation path exists anywhere for the AdvisoryProvider chain to be tested against -- RI currently affects zero Advisory reasoning output in this repository. Reclassified true-consumption effort from 3I's S (which scoped only the attachment work 3J implemented) to L, citing the missing contract amendment, the absent real (non-mock, non-human-relay) provider -- CurrentActingModelAdvisoryProvider requires its answer supplied at construction time by whichever operator is running the session, not a live call -- the absent production entry point (zero existing call sites to wire from), and F1 (symlink provenance) needing repair before RI could safely influence any actual reasoning output (reclassified from ACCEPTABLE NON-BLOCKING for the current attachment-only state to MUST REPAIR BEFORE TRUE REASONING CONSUMPTION). Confirmed the existing 115Q/115R architecture already structurally guarantees authority separation (RawAdvisoryResponse's _UNAUTHORIZED_RESPONSE_FIELDS rejects verdict/commit/push/authorized/execute/finalize outright; performed_flags always False) -- a genuine asset for any future Option-A phase. Assessed a reasoning threat model (malicious/tampered/stale/foreign/malformed artifacts, context poisoning, prompt injection, deterministic manipulation) and found several gaps (artifact integrity, context poisoning, prompt injection) unaddressed by any frozen contract today. Re-compared Candidate A (rollback readiness/evidence, S-M effort, LOW risk, per 3I) and Candidate B (runtime preflight, lowest priority, per 3I) without reopening either in depth; concluded Candidate A now outranks a future Option-A attempt given Option A's reclassified L effort. Recommended Option B: release the already-independently-verified (3J.1) attachment-only integration as a narrow patch (v0.4.2-plausible) with corrected release language ('automatically attaches available Repository Intelligence context, provenance, and limitations' -- never 'RI now drives Advisory reasoning'), and reprioritize Candidate A as the next capability. Updated PROJECT_STATUS.md's Current Phase section and CHANGELOG.md's Unreleased section to reflect this phase and to keep the 122A-scoped Advisory-reasoning-consumption gap explicitly recorded as open, without rewriting any historical phase report. No implementation performed: true RI reasoning consumption not built, F1 not repaired, no provider/model call added, no version bump, no release/tag action, Candidate A/B not implemented. Article remains STOPPED; ~/repos/pcae-deepseek-research untouched, out of scope, not inspected. v0.4.1 remains the current unmodified public release. Human decision on release/priority selection required; no next phase begun.
